name: Ricotte
source: The runaway girl who fell into the protagonist's life. She's unwavering despite knowing little about the world, but really she's a nice young lady. The look on her eyes changes whenever the subject of her singing skills comes up in conversation. She was actually the youngest and most famous songstress in Alpenbul. She had fun when she first started singing, but when she fell under the Roquefort Company's control, she soon buckled under the stress and couldn't sing. After a massive blunder at her concert, she ran away and later met the protagonist.
